blocks.text: Predicate logic mein quantifiers yeh batane ke liye istemal hote hain ke kitni cheezein (objects) kisi shart (condition) ko poora karti hain. In se hum aam (general) statements bhi bana sakte hain aur khaas cheezon ke baare mein statements bhi. Quantifiers predicate logic ko propositional logic se zyada taqatwar banate hain. In se hum “Tamam students mehnati hain” ya “Kuch kitabein dilchasp hain” jaise statements likh sakte hain. Quantifiers knowledge ko saaf aur theek theek (precisely) likhne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: “For all” (sab ke liye) ya “there exists” (koi ek maujood hai) jaise quantifiers aam qaide ya imkanat (possibilities) saaf bayan karne mein madad dete hain.
Universal Quantifier (for all, sab ke liye)

Universal quantifier batata hai ke statement kisi set ki tamam cheezon ke liye sach hai (Figure 2.8 dekhein). Is ka nishaan “∀” hai (ulta A). Maslan “∀x, x > 0” ka matlab hai “har x ke liye, x zero se bara hai.” Universal quantifier kisi domain (group) ki har cheez ke baare mein aam statement banata hai. Maths aur logic ke proofs (saboot) mein yeh aham hai. “For all” kehne ka matlab hai ke set ki koi bhi cheez is statement ko nahi torti. Yeh quantifier qaide aur aam sachaiyan saaf bayan karta hai.
Existential Quantifier (there exists, koi ek maujood hai)

Existential quantifier batata hai ke statement set ki kam az kam ek cheez ke liye sach hai (Figure 2.8 dekhein). Is ka nishaan “∃” hai (ulta E). Maslan “∃x, x is even” ka matlab hai “kam az kam ek x aisa maujood hai jo even (juft) hai.” Yeh quantifier tab istemal hota hai jab shart kuch cheezein poori karti hon, zaroori nahi ke sab. Is se imkanat aur khaas misalein bayan hoti hain. Problem solving aur reasoning ke liye existential quantifier aham hai.

blocks.alt: Do column. Universal Quantifier: ulte A ki alamat aur x wala box, teer neeche 'For all x, P(x)' tak. Existential Quantifier: ulte E ki alamat aur x wala box, teer neeche 'For some x, P(x)' tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.8: Universal aur existential quantifier (kitab ki Figure 2.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baayen ∀x ka matlab “For all x, P(x)”: P(x) har x ke liye sach. Daayen ∃x ka matlab “For some x, P(x)”: P(x) kam az kam ek x ke liye sach. Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: ∀ = ulta A (All), ∃ = ulta E (Exists).
Logical statements mein quantifiers ka istemal

Quantifiers ko predicates ke saath mila kar saaf logical statements bante hain. Maslan “∀x, P(x)” ka matlab hai predicate P(x) har x ke liye sach hai, jabke “∃x, P(x)” ka matlab hai P(x) kam az kam ek x ke liye sach hai. Quantifiers mushkil statements mein ek saath bhi aa sakte hain. Maslan “∀x ∃y, x < y” ka matlab hai har x ke liye koi aisa y maujood hai jo x se bara ho. Quantifiers se qaide, shartein aur rishte saaf likhe ja sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Quantifier ki shakal mein likhein: (a) Class ka har student pass hua. (b) Class ke kisi student ne poore marks liye.

items: Quantifier batata hai kitni cheezein shart poori karti hain.
Universal ∀ (for all): sab ke liye sach; existential ∃ (there exists): kam az kam ek ke liye sach.
Dono ek saath bhi aate hain: ∀x ∃y, x < y (har x se bara koi y hai).
